# next-md-negotiate

> A TypeScript library for serving Markdown to AI agents and HTML to people from the same Next.js URL through HTTP content negotiation.

## When to use this

Use next-md-negotiate when a Next.js application has authored Markdown representations for selected pages and wants agents to request them without maintaining parallel public URLs.

It is a good fit when:

- the browser experience must remain HTML;
- agents benefit from smaller, structured Markdown;
- both representations should share one canonical URL;
- route parameters should remain type-safe.

It is not an HTML-to-Markdown converter, hosted API, or MCP server. Applications define the Markdown content they want to serve.

## How agents should read this site

Request the exact page URL with the HTTP header `Accept: text/markdown`. Supported pages return `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`. If Markdown is unavailable, follow the documentation index or sitemap instead of guessing routes.
